name: Degoog
short_desc: Private metasearch engine, no Google, no tracking
author: fccview
description:
Degoog is a self-hosted, privacy-respecting metasearch engine. It aggregates results from multiple engines without profiling, logging or ads, and supports themes, shortcuts (bangs), an optional indexer and extensions.

This definition uses the minimal single-container setup (in-memory cache). Valkey and PostgreSQL backends exist upstream for high-traffic public instances and are not included here.

form_fields.label: Settings password
form_fields.hint: Protects admin and extension-store actions. Required: an unlocked instance lets anyone install extensions, which runs code on the server.

form_fields.label: Public instance
form_fields.hint: Keep every admin and store action behind the password, even from the local network.
